Recovery.requestIntro: If the Owner of {home} has permanently lost access to their account and cannot be reached, a long-standing member can ask Madeora to make them the Owner.
Recovery.requestBeforeReset: If the Owner only forgot their password, they can reset it from the sign-in page. That is always faster.
Recovery.requestBeforeContact: Try to reach the Owner yourself first. If they can still sign in, they can hand ownership over from the Home's leave page.
Recovery.requestEligibility: You can ask if you are an Administrator or Member, your email address is confirmed and you joined this Home at least 30 days ago.
Recovery.requestWhatHappens: Madeora staff check your request themselves and may contact you to verify who you are. The Owner is emailed. If staff approve, the other members have 14 days to object before you can accept.
Recovery.requestPrivacy: What you write goes to Madeora staff only. Other members see only that a review is open.
Recovery.statementHint: Why the Owner cannot be reached, what you have tried, and how staff can verify who you are (for example a phone number for a video call).

Recovery.stateReady: The objection period is over. You can accept ownership of {home} now.
Recovery.statePaused: Your request is paused while Madeora staff look into an objection or a question.
Recovery.stateRejected: Madeora staff did not approve your request.
Recovery.stateCancelled: The Owner ended your request because they still have access. Contact them directly.
Recovery.stateOwnerReturned: The Owner has signed in since you asked, so your request stopped. Contact them directly.

Recovery.acceptedNotice: You are now the Owner of {home}.
Recovery.withdrawConfirmText: Madeora staff stop reviewing it. You can ask again later.

NotificationSettings.title: Notification settings
NotificationSettings.intro: Your choices apply to you only. Nobody else, not even a Home's Owner, can see or change them.
NotificationSettings.essentialText: Messages about your account, sign-in security and ownership recovery are always on. They cannot be switched off or delayed, and no Home setting changes that.
NotificationSettings.accountHint: These apply in every Home unless you set something different for that Home.
NotificationSettings.homesHint: A Home inherits your defaults until you change something for it. Changing your defaults later reaches every Home that still inherits them.
NotificationSettings.noHomes: You do not belong to a Home yet.
NotificationSettings.categoryInvitationsHint: Someone asking to join a Home you manage, and the answer to your own requests.

NotificationSettings.quietHint: Quiet hours delay optional emails until they end. In-app notifications still appear at once, and security messages are never delayed.

Storage.title: Storage
Storage.personalIntro: Your own storage holds the pictures and files you upload yourself, such as your profile pictures. Each Home has its own storage, separate from yours.
Storage.homeIntro: This Home's storage holds the files that belong to the Home. Your own uploads count against your personal storage, not this one.
Storage.deletedHint: Deleted files can be recovered for 7 days and keep counting until then. After that, their space is freed.
Storage.warningPersonal: Your storage is more than 80% full. Remove files you no longer need to keep room for new uploads.
Storage.warningHome: This Home's storage is more than 80% full. Remove files the Home no longer needs to keep room for new uploads.
Storage.criticalPersonal: Your storage is almost full (95%). New uploads will soon be refused; everything else keeps working.
Storage.criticalHome: This Home's storage is almost full (95%). New uploads will soon be refused; everything else keeps working.

Trash.title: Trash
Trash.settingsCardHint: Items you deleted can be restored for 7 days.
Trash.personalIntro: Items you deleted stay here for 7 days. You can restore them, or delete them permanently to free their storage space right away. After 7 days they are removed automatically and cannot be restored.
Trash.homeIntroManager: Items deleted in this Home stay here for 7 days. As a Home manager you see everything deleted in this Home. Restoring puts an item back where it was, and deleting permanently frees this Home's storage.
Trash.homeIntroMember: Items you deleted in this Home stay here for 7 days. You see only what you deleted yourself; the Home's managers see everything. After 7 days items are removed automatically and cannot be restored.
Trash.notAvailable: This Home's trash is not available to you.
